instruction: Right now you are standing on the stair case. Just step down the stair case in front you can see a portrait on a wall. Beside the portrait there is a open entrance, just step into the open entrance and walk through the corridor in front you can see another open entrance, just step into that another open entrance in front you can see a open door just step into that open door. On you are right side you can see a sofa, go near to the edge of the sofa stand in front of the sofa. Here we reached our destination.
